ns2:course.label: Introduction to Bioengineering
ns2:course.description: Lectures and discussions of recent trends in bioengineering; topics typically include biological interaction with ultrasound and microwave radiation, modeling, instrumentation, biomaterials, biomechanics, biological heat and mass transfer, and medical imaging techniques.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Bioengineering department.
